newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila Central Bank cuts 3-mth T-bill rate.
newsitem.headline: Manila Central Bank cuts 3-mth T-bill rate.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Wednesday it lowered its borrowing rate on the three-month special series Treasury bills to 10.6 percent from 10.7 percent.
Traders said the move was to align with the results of the weekly auction of Treasury bills held on Tuesday.
Treasury bill rates fell after rising in the past month as Central Bank increased its key overnight borrowing rate several times to quell peso speculation.
